verses.text: al hamdu lil laahil lazii yubaddilu
sayyi-atan hasanatan wa yujzilu
wa salawaatu halaa man qubilaa
jamiihu maa ataa bihi wa fuddilaa
haazaa wa innil yawma taa-ibun ilaa
rabbin ghafuurin raajiyan taqabbulaa
mustashfihan bifadlihi wa jaahi
habiibihil maahii haziimil jaahi
yaa rabbanaa innii atuubul yawmaa
faltaqinii dunyaa wa ukhraa lawmaa
yaa rabbanaa innii muqirrun biz zunuub
faligh firiz zunuuba waltamhul huyuub
yaa rabbanaa bil mujtabaa taqabbali
jamiiha maa qaddamtuhu min hamali
yaa rabbanaa bihaqqi bismil laahi
hab liya hismatan bilaa tanaahi
yaa rabbanaa bil mustafaa wal aali
wa bis sahaabatis tajib su-aalii
wa salliyan wa salliman halan nabii
wa aalihi wa liya jud bil adabi
wa salliyan wa salliman halar rasuul
wa aalihi wa liya hab bihil wusuul
wa salliyan wa salliman halal mabarr
wa aalihi wa liya hab bihiz zafar
wa salliya wa salliman halal bashiir
wa aalihi wa liya kun bihi nasiir
wa salliyan wa salliman halan naziir
wa aalihi wa liya kun bihi ghafuur
wa salliyan wa salliman halal mutaah
wa aalihi wa liya hab bihit tibaah
wa salliyan wa salliman halal kariim
wa aalihi wa liya hab bihil huluum
wa salliyan wa salliman halal hudaa
wa aalihi wa liya hab bihih tidaa
wa salliyan wa salliman halal hudaa
wa aalihi waltakfinii bihih tidaa
wa salliyan wa salliman halal hudaa
wa aalihi wa liya hab bihiq tidaa
wa salliyan wa salliman halayhi
wa aalihi wa man numii ilayhi
wa salliyan halayhi summa sallimaa
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa hazzimaa
warzuqniyal yawma bijaahihil haziim
tarkab tidaahin qad tajurru lil aliim
wa salliyan halayhi summa sallimaa
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa karrimaa
warzuqbiyal yawma bihin najaataa
minal hidaa warzuq biyal hufaataa
wa salliyan halayhi summa sallimaa
wal aali was sahbi wa man lahun tamaa
warzuqniyal yawma bihis sakiinah
walturinil kahbata wal madiinah
wa salliyan wa salliman halayhi
wa aalihi wa sahbihi ladayhi
warzuqniyal yawma bihis sabaataa
fiika wa fiihi rabbi wan nabaataa
wa salliyan wa salliman halayhi
wa aalihi wa man jaraa ilayhi
warzuqniyal yawma bihis sawaabaa
fii kulli maa afhalu was sawaabaa
